description: Vocabulary of the per-draft EvalResult evals (HAR-97 §3-§6, §9, §15(GTM)) and of the offline-benchmark situations (§20): per eval type its kind, its ONE evidence class, its labels ([] = label null), whether and when it may block, and the HAR-97 sections it implements. HAR-97 evals that do not produce an EvalResult on a draft are listed in out_of_scope with the reason and where they are measured. HAR-97 has two '# 15.' and two '# 16.' headings: '§15(GTM).n' is the GTM-grounded evals, '§16(DEMO)' the primary demo objective; L1-L5 are the five eval layers; '§n(PITCH)' is a section of the 'Core demo pitch' at the top of HAR-97. Routing by StateTransition (to_state, status) is contracts/transitions/routing.v1.json (ADR-0012).

evidence_classes.deal_data: Observed customer or deal behaviour only: Gong/Salesloft-style won-vs-lost analyses of stakeholder coverage, next-step behaviour, engagement and timing, and the buyer's own first-party evidence.
evidence_classes.methodology: Established enterprise-sales methodology (MEDDPICC: economic buyer, champion, decision criteria and process, metrics/pain, compelling event; mutual action plans).
evidence_classes.cs_ops: Operational expansion/customer-success systems (Gainsight-style product use, stakeholder engagement, risk, support and expansion signals).
evidence_classes.product_rule: A hard product, policy or data rule of this platform; used only for deterministic, trace and human-delta evals.

recipient_correctness.description: Recipients exist, belong to the intended account (or our org), are not duplicated, and no internal-only contact is externalized. Code answers it from identities and account state; who SHOULD receive the action is stakeholder_selection.

date_commitment_consistency.description: Dates match current state, meeting times are not stale, the action does not contradict a commitment already made, a referenced asset exists.

pricing_integrity.description: No unsupported price or invented discount; correct product, plan, region and quantities per source evidence.

crm_writeback.description: Stage update is legal, owner exists, next step does not overwrite newer or higher-standing state (ADR-0008/0009), correct opportunity/account.

duplicate_action.description: The same email, meeting or CRM action was not already sent, scheduled or completed.

provenance_coverage.description: Critical factual statements carry supporting state or evidence references.

permission_policy.description: Allowed tool, correct account/workspace, within the permitted autonomy level, no confidential material outside its sharing condition, dry runs cannot write.

state_transition_support.description: Is the transition the draft relies on supported by evidence? Code re-derives its status from the rule set at its rule_set_version and the AccountState version it cites; every satisfied fact must cite evidence. Never decides the state and uses no model (ADR-0012).
state_transition_support.label_rule: NO_TRANSITION (verdict abstain) when the run was given no transition; UNSUPPORTED (fail) when the re-derived status, target or fact lists differ from the transition the draft relied on, or a satisfied fact cites no evidence; otherwise SUPPORTED (pass).
state_transition_support.blocking_rule: Blocks every UNSUPPORTED: the decision rests on a state the evidence has not earned. NO_TRANSITION never blocks.

buyer_readiness.description: Whether there is a real buyer-side reason to act now, given what the buyer has done and said (MEDDPICC compelling event).
buyer_readiness.blocking_rule: Blocks only when the action asks the buyer to commit past an open technical or security gate they have not cleared (a signature or order-form push, or a review date before the requested evidence is read); any other TOO_EARLY fail revises.

cta_calibration.description: Size and type of the ask relative to the state of the relationship (HAR-97 ask_strength, upper-cased).
cta_calibration.blocking_rule: Block only when the ask is a closing commitment (signature, order, payment or a fixed deadline) that the buyer has not signalled; any other mis-sized ask fails without blocking and goes to revision.

next_step_quality.description: A concrete, mutually understood next step with owners and, where agreed, a date; no invented buyer commitment.
next_step_quality.blocking_rule: Block when the action leaves no mutual next step at all while a customer request or an overdue commitment is open; a step that only lacks an owner or a date fails without blocking.

stakeholder_selection.description: Whether the RIGHT people are involved: not bypassing the active champion, security material to the security stakeholder, no unrequested executive, no explicitly required stakeholder omitted, no unverified addressee for commercial material. Breadth is stakeholder_coverage.
stakeholder_selection.blocking_rule: Block when the action omits a stakeholder the customer explicitly required, or sends commercial or confidential material to an addressee not verified in the buying group; otherwise fail revises.

stakeholder_coverage.description: Breadth: whether this action involves more or fewer people than the situation requires (§5.4, 'separate from stakeholder selection'), and whether the deal's multithreading fits its stage (§15(GTM).3).
stakeholder_coverage.label_rule: UNDER_THREADED / RIGHT_SIZED / OVER_THREADED judge the action's recipients (§5.4); SINGLE_THREADED_RISK and OVER_THREADED_TOO_EARLY judge the deal's coverage (§15(GTM).3) when that is the issue.
stakeholder_coverage.blocking_rule: Block when executives or unrelated stakeholders are pulled in while the working-level step is still under way, or a gating role the customer named (e.g. security) is not engaged; a merely broad or narrow thread fails without blocking.

economic_buyer_coverage.description: Who can approve the decision is understood and the action helps reach them appropriately (MEDDPICC economic buyer).
economic_buyer_coverage.blocking_rule: Never blocks: an unknown economic buyer with spend approved in writing is a warn; with spend not yet approved it is a fail that revises.

champion_strength.description: Whether the champion has influence and motivation to move the deal, and whether the action strengthens or weakens them (MEDDPICC champion).
champion_strength.blocking_rule: Never blocks: it explains or qualifies; the action-level evals carry the block.

champion_continuity.description: The action preserves a valuable relationship path: the active champion stays involved unless ownership was explicitly delegated or the champion left (methodology, like champion_strength: both are the MEDDPICC champion).
champion_continuity.blocking_rule: Block when the label is CHAMPION_BYPASSED: the active champion is dropped although ownership was not explicitly delegated and the champion did not leave.

decision_process.description: The action respects how the customer decides: criteria, approval sequence, security/legal/procurement steps, paper process (MEDDPICC decision/paper process).
decision_process.blocking_rule: Block when the action skips or contradicts a gate the customer stated (security sign-off, legal, procurement, a named approver), e.g. a signature or go-live push before that gate; an unknown process fails without blocking.

business_case.description: Value claims connect to the customer's stated pain and metrics, without inflating them (MEDDPICC metrics/pain).
business_case.blocking_rule: Never blocks: it explains or qualifies; the action-level evals carry the block.

momentum.description: Whether the action matches the account's engagement trajectory.
momentum.blocking_rule: Never blocks: it explains or qualifies; the action-level evals carry the block.

action_stage_fit.description: The kind of action fits where the account is in the buying or expansion process (no pricing push before technical validation, no commercial follow-up during recovery).
action_stage_fit.blocking_rule: Block when the action is a commercial or closing push at a stage that has not reached it (discovery, technical validation, recovery or an at-risk renewal).

expansion_readiness.description: Whether adoption, health, support state and need support an expansion action now; one positive signal is not enough.
expansion_readiness.blocking_rule: Never blocks: it explains or qualifies; the action-level evals carry the block.

customer_risk_sensitivity.description: The commercial action fits current customer risk: severe support issues suppress upsell, deterioration changes channel and pressure.
customer_risk_sensitivity.blocking_rule: Block when the action pushes commercial or operational steps into an open severe incident, a compliance risk, or a hold the customer asked for.

relationship_pressure.description: Commercial pressure fits the relationship and state (no urgency after a concern, no repeated nudges without news, no expansion language during recovery).
relationship_pressure.blocking_rule: Never blocks: it explains or qualifies; the action-level evals carry the block.

timing_cadence.description: Even if the action is right, whether now is the right time given last outbound/inbound, response windows and promised deadlines.
timing_cadence.blocking_rule: Block when the window the customer opened has passed and the action still treats it as open (a stale day, a past slot).

next_action_quality.description: Of the possible actions, whether this is the best next move, including WAIT and NO_ACTION.
next_action_quality.blocking_rule: Block when the candidate withholds or replaces what the customer asked for now (ACT_NOW), or acts although the right move is NO_ACTION on a trigger that needs no customer contact; NEEDS_REVISION and a premature-but-harmless move fail without blocking.

grounding.description: Claims, rationale and action follow from the account state and the buyer's own evidence, not generic best practice.
grounding.blocking_rule: Block when the action states a fact the evidence contradicts or does not contain (an invented approver, outranked third-party data, a quote that says the opposite); unsupported emphasis fails without blocking.

commitment_consistency.description: The action respects what both sides already promised and does not jump ahead of or re-promise commitments (mutual action plan).
commitment_consistency.blocking_rule: Block when the action ignores an open commitment our side owes, treats an unaccepted proposal as agreed, or re-promises a fulfilled commitment.

state_change_relevance.description: The action responds to what actually changed, not to historically salient but stale topics.
state_change_relevance.blocking_rule: Block when the action ignores the material change and acts on a stale or non-deal topic.

channel_appropriateness.description: Email, meeting, internal task, CRM update or nothing external at all - whichever the situation calls for.
channel_appropriateness.blocking_rule: Block when customer-facing content goes to an internal-only channel (or internal content to the customer), or the channel replaces what the customer explicitly asked to receive.

rep_style.description: Consistent with the rep's own communication style without changing strategic content.
rep_style.blocking_rule: Never blocks: it explains or qualifies; the action-level evals carry the block.

knowledge_applicability.description: Retrieved company knowledge actually applies to this account state. Methodology, not deal_data: learned knowledge is not presented as empirically proven (§15(GTM)).
knowledge_applicability.blocking_rule: Never blocks: it explains or qualifies; the action-level evals carry the block.
knowledge_applicability.label_rule: Signature first (ADR-0011): DOES_NOT_APPLY if any signature condition fails; EXCEPTION_TRIGGERED if the signature holds and an exception holds; otherwise APPLIES. 'diff.<signal_type>' conditions match open signals.

exception_awareness.description: The draft notices an exception in current state that overrides a learned default (delegation, departure, a reviewer's own request).
exception_awareness.blocking_rule: Blocks only when the missed exception rests on the customer's explicit written instruction: the draft then contradicts what the customer said.

evidence_sufficiency.description: Whether there is enough trusted evidence to decide at all, or the agent should gather more context or route to a human.
evidence_sufficiency.blocking_rule: Never blocks: insufficient evidence routes to more context or human review instead.

trajectory.description: The whole run: correct trigger, relevant context and knowledge, correct tools and arguments, no write before approval or after a blocking eval, dry runs non-writing.

human_delta.description: What the human changed, literally and semantically, and whether an existing eval predicted it.

decision_grounding.blocking_rule: Never blocks until its agreement against reference answers is measured; advisory until then.
decision_grounding.description: Whether the strategy's rationale and assumptions follow from the account state and the buyer's own evidence, not from facts the state marks unknown or contradicted.

artifact_grounding.blocking_rule: Never blocks until its agreement against reference answers is measured; advisory until then.
artifact_grounding.description: Whether every claim in the action artifact (the email) is supported by the account's own evidence.

decision_timing.blocking_rule: Never blocks until its agreement against reference answers is measured; advisory until then.
decision_timing.description: Whether the strategy's timing premise respects commitments and the dates the buyer has set.

artifact_timing.blocking_rule: Never blocks until its agreement against reference answers is measured; advisory until then.
artifact_timing.description: Whether the dates and the proposed time in the action artifact fall inside the buyer's window and agree with commitments.

trigger_eval.reason: Judges whether the agent should have run at all, before any draft exists; its outcome is a TriggerEvaluation (eligible + reason_codes), not an EvalResult on a draft. HAR-97's RUN_AGENT / WAIT / NO_ACTION / COALESCE_WITH_PENDING_EVENT / HUMAN_REVIEW have no contract vocabulary yet.

decision_ranking.reason: Compares several candidate actions for one situation; EvalResult judges one draft. Needs a ranking result contract.
decision_ranking.measured_by: no WP17-WP27 issue names it; closest owners are WP19 (HAR-117, the account agent chooses among actions) and WP23 (HAR-121, metrics); fixtures/evals expected_best_action is the seed

l1_context_state.reason: Judges the state the agent saw (identity, stage, blockers, stale facts, conflicts), not the draft.
l1_context_state.measured_by: gold checkpoints and the context-layer benchmark (HAR-96 §16, bench/)

l4_knowledge_learning.reason: Extraction fidelity, scope/exception quality, uplift (A/B/C runs) and negative transfer judge the learner and controlled re-runs, not one draft. L4 applicability is knowledge_applicability above.

l5_meta_evals.reason: Evaluates the evaluators against human gold; it is a metric over this catalog, not an eval type.
l5_meta_evals.measured_by: agreement over fixtures/evals: WP18 (HAR-116) judge runs, WP23 (HAR-121) eval-of-evals

transition_detection.reason: Whether we inferred the right relationship state, marked uncertain transitions CANDIDATE or UNRESOLVED and kept contradicting evidence judges the detector over gold, not one draft.
transition_detection.measured_by: HAR-126 detector: status accuracy and supporting/missing fact precision and recall against WP29 gold, plus a no-premature-promotion test

case_types.too_soon_cta: A call to action before the buyer is ready for it.
case_types.too_late_follow_up: A follow-up after the window the buyer opened has passed.
case_types.correct_timing: A well-timed action (control for the timing evals).
case_types.over_threading: More people pulled in than the step needs.
case_types.under_threading: Too few of the people the step or the deal needs.
case_types.champion_bypass: A new thread that drops the active champion.
case_types.valid_champion_handoff: A direct thread that is right because ownership was delegated or the champion left.
case_types.wrong_channel: The right content in the wrong channel or format.
case_types.stale_commitment: An action built on a fulfilled, past or forgotten commitment.
case_types.unresolved_blocker: An action that talks past an open blocker.
case_types.no_action: Waiting or doing nothing is correct (and candidates that act anyway).
case_types.duplicate_action: Repeating what was already sent or proposed.
case_types.conflicting_account_state: Sources disagree; the action follows standing and surfaces the conflict (ADR-0008).
case_types.insufficient_evidence: The context does not support the claim or the action.
case_types.applicable_knowledge: Offered knowledge that applies and should be followed.
case_types.misleading_similar_knowledge: Knowledge that looks relevant but whose signature or exception rules it out.
case_types.explicit_exception: An explicit exception to a learned rule that the action must honour.
